issues.description: Method SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(Meal): The problem statement (UML and text) specifies that calculateTotalPrice should return a double (for accurate financial calculations). The solution implementation defines calculateTotalPrice as returning an int. This mismatch between 'double' in the problem statement and 'int' in the solution creates API inconsistency and may cause confusion or compilation/test expectation mismatches for students and graders.
issues.suggestedFix: Make SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice return a double to match the problem statement and UML. Update the method signature to 'public static double calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)' and use a double accumulator when summing ingredient prices (e.g., double sum = 0.0; sum += ingredient.getPrice();). Update any callers/tests to expect a double return value if necessary.
